title: Implement authenticated bounded realtime admission

evidence_required: Probe REALTIME-STORAGE covers FT-003-AC-006, REQ-DIAG-001, REQ-SEC-001, REQ-ARCH-001 and the task-applicable persistence/ownership claims in .memory-bank/domains/display-client-access.md and .memory-bank/domains/promo-attempt.md#postgresql-shape. RED: before behavior changes, an isolated migration/repository matrix must show the display-client digest lifecycle and core Attempt immutable admission snapshot/unique key do not exist or violate owner/cascade rules. GREEN: the same matrix distinguishes provision/authenticate/reset/deactivate/restart, plaintext absence, authoritative spa_id derivation, one core Attempt snapshot, state constraints, no Photo/diagnostic ownership-crossing cascade and owner-only writes; retain actual direct down_revision, upgrade/downgrade/re-upgrade and data comparisons without treating a later mutable head as exact.

Probe REALTIME-ADMISSION covers FT-003-AC-006, the server-persisted request-manifest timing subset of FT-003-AC-010, REQ-CAP-002, REQ-DIAG-001, REQ-PERF-001 and the task-applicable claims in .memory-bank/contracts/realtime-attempt-api.md#endpoint-and-authentication, #multipart-serialization, #manifest-version-1 and #admission-idempotency-and-failures. RED: before behavior changes, an isolated HTTP matrix must show the exact route/auth/body guard/parser/strict validation or admission persistence is absent, or that distinct reference_series_ready_at, local_detection_completed_ms and request_started_ms fields are not retained. GREEN: the claim-equivalent report distinguishes valid zero/one/twenty requests, exact parts/manifest/omissions, 20,971,520 versus 20,971,521 bytes, 401/413/422/429/503/5xx, admitted typed fake-downstream outcomes, core Attempt presence/absence and persistence of those three request-manifest fields with decisive comparisons; it explicitly does not claim client-local response receipt or the complete diagnostic timeline.

Probe REALTIME-IDEMPOTENCY covers FT-003-AC-006, REQ-DIAG-001 and only the FT-003-applicable idempotency claims in .memory-bank/contracts/realtime-attempt-api.md and .memory-bank/domains/promo-attempt.md#admission-and-transitions. RED: concurrent and repeated (spa_id, attempt_id) requests must show the absent owner cannot guarantee one row, at most one downstream call, immutable snapshot or terminal/non-terminal repeat behavior. GREEN: the same controlled fixture records one row/call, unchanged snapshot, persisted terminal read or in_progress response and separate results for zero-proposal and admitted technical failure; it uses a fake typed processing/result adapter and explicitly does not claim FT-004 singleton search, result assembly or restart interruption.

Probe REALTIME-SECURITY covers FT-003-AC-006, the server-facing part of FT-003-AC-009, REQ-SEC-001 and REQ-ARCH-001. RED: the effective topology/redaction/ownership trace must fail if a token/digest/Auth header, client-supplied spa_id, private port, direct handler/composition repository write, custom error envelope or FT-004 search/result logic appears. GREEN: the same probe records private service topology, per-token/IP limit, log/URL/body redaction, principal-derived spa_id, promo and serving_control ownership, typed processing port and negative source/runtime checks for every forbidden bypass with distinguishable results.

All T3 probes use a unique disposable Compose project, generated test display tokens, controlled body streams, fake downstream processing, current linear migration head, safe rerun and owned cleanup; they never use production credentials, media or operator/default volumes. Independent /verify supplies fresh functional evidence and VERDICT: PASS; per-task /red-verify supplies SEMANTIC_VERDICT: semantic-pass. After these tier obligations pass, the explicit lifecycle owner records the closure decision.
purpose: Create the server-side authentication and admission boundary that converts one valid bounded client request into exactly one immutable core Attempt without implementing later search/result behavior.
success_outcome: The exact realtime endpoint derives СПА from a hashed active display token, rejects transport/auth/validation/readiness failures before admission, persists one immutable core Attempt for each admitted key, returns the accepted zero/fake-downstream typed outcomes idempotently and retains the accepted request-manifest timing fields without leaking credentials or opening private services.
anti_goals: Do not implement FT-004 proposal selection, singleton search/deadline/restart interruption, candidate/result/session assembly or exact face-search behavior; use a narrow fake/typed downstream port.
Do not implement FT-005 Promo rendering/acknowledgement, FT-006 QR continuation, detailed diagnostic evidence or client offline outbox.
Do not add a custom error framework, waiter queue, broker, event channel, distributed rate limiter or direct handler/composition-root business writes.
Do not expose plaintext tokens/digests, trust client spa_id, publish PostgreSQL/MinIO/internal ports or touch production data/credentials.

forbidden_scope: FT-005/FT-006 Promo/QR behavior and detailed diagnostics/retention
Production credentials, operator/default volumes, public internal ports and destructive data actions
Direct transport/composition writes to serving_control or promo repositories and cross-owner database cascade
stop_conditions: The exact realtime endpoint, multipart/manifest, body bound, standard failure, idempotency or core Attempt contract would need to change.
Admission cannot remain owned by promo or token state by serving_control without direct foreign writes or a new architecture edge.
A complete FT-003 admission seam cannot be delivered without implementing FT-004 search/result/restart behavior or changing that feature dependency.
Any harm-driving auth/body/admission probe cannot run in isolated disposable state with safe rerun and owned cleanup.

constraints: Primary orchestration owner is promo at src/face_moment/promo/; serving_control at src/face_moment/serving_control/ authenticates and returns only the display-client principal, and realtime transport/composition only adapt.
Author the migration from the actual current linear Alembic head and verify only its direct ancestry, upgrade/downgrade, schema transition and data behavior.
Persist every admitted immutable client/serving snapshot before downstream work; use a typed fake processing/result adapter in this task and leave the FT-004 implementation absent.
Enforce the total body limit at the edge/realtime transport before multipart parsing/domain admission and introduce no additional aggregate-pixel, per-JPEG-byte or manifest-size cap.
Use high-entropy central display tokens, SHA-256 digests, deployment-configured positive per-token/IP limits and standard HTTP statuses without a custom envelope.
invariants: Transport/auth/validation/rate/readiness rejection creates no core Attempt; an admitted zero-proposal request creates exactly one.
The server derives spa_id only from one active display-client token and never stores/logs plaintext or accepts a client override.
One (spa_id, client_attempt_id) owns one immutable snapshot and at most one downstream execution; repeats cannot overwrite or duplicate it.
Promo is the only core Attempt writer and serving_control the only display-token writer; database cascade cannot cross Photo/diagnostic ownership boundaries.
This task exposes only FT-003 admission/idempotency seams and does not claim FT-004 search, result assembly, singleton/deadline or restart interruption.
verification_targets: REALTIME-STORAGE -> FT-003-AC-006, REQ-DIAG-001, REQ-SEC-001 and REQ-ARCH-001 with separate migration, display-token, Attempt-shape, ownership and cascade results.

REALTIME-ADMISSION -> FT-003-AC-006, the server-persisted request-manifest timing subset of FT-003-AC-010, REQ-CAP-002, REQ-DIAG-001 and REQ-PERF-001 with separate multipart/body/status/admission/outcome and reference_series_ready_at/local_detection_completed_ms/request_started_ms persistence results; client response receipt remains outside this server probe.
REALTIME-IDEMPOTENCY -> FT-003-AC-006 and REQ-DIAG-001 with separate one-row/one-call/snapshot/terminal/non-terminal repeat results and explicit FT-004 exclusion.
REALTIME-SECURITY -> FT-003-AC-006, FT-003-AC-009, REQ-SEC-001 and REQ-ARCH-001 with separate rate, redaction, private-topology and owner/bypass results.
